game_concept: A action puzzle set in Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon, a lagoon of pearl divers: the dock cartographer must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Rule Duel: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel.
theme: Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon: a lagoon of pearl divers
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Arithmetic procedures: double every value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 1, operand 7.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rule Duel' (Week 3 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Pearl Divers' Lagoon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Collect 220 points of ship ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Rule Duel – Pearl Divers' Lagoon Rush
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
